newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Finolex to build LNG complex.
newsitem.headline: India's Finolex to build LNG complex.

text.p: India's Finolex Industries has been chosen by the government to build a liquified natural gas (LNG) complex in the southern port city of Mangalore, the company's chairman said.

"Yes, we won the bid, but it is too early to talk about it," Finolex Industries chairman Pralhad Chhabria told Reuters on Tuesday. He indicated the group was keen on roping in a partner with interests in natural gas production.
Finolex Industries makes plastic irrigation pipes and its raw material polyvinyl chloride (PVC). Another group firm Finolex Cables is a leading telecommunications cable maker.
The LNG will be used to fire a 500 MW power plant the group plans to build in Kasargod in Kerala and other private power units coming up in the region, Chhabria said.
